# Design Vortex

> Design Vortex is a digital character art commission studio. Founded by artist Hector G. in 2024, the studio has delivered 200+ hand-painted character portraits for D&D, TTRPG, and fantasy clients worldwide. Every commission is painted by a human in Procreate, Photoshop, or Clip Studio Paint — never generated or assisted by AI.

The studio specialises in custom D&D and tabletop RPG character art including character portraits, VTT tokens, party portraits, NPC packs, world-building art for game masters, anime-style commissions, and commercial illustration for publishers.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://designvortex.co/): overview of the studio, services, and recent work
- [Services](https://designvortex.co/services): full commission menu — character art, party portraits, VTT tokens, NPC packs, custom projects
- [Portfolio](https://designvortex.co/portfolio): 200+ delivered commissions, filterable by category and style
- [Pricing](https://designvortex.co/pricing): transparent flat-rate pricing for every commission type
- [Order](https://designvortex.co/order): start a commission brief
- [Process](https://designvortex.co/process): how commissions work from brief to delivery
- [About](https://designvortex.co/about): about the studio and the artist Hector G.
- [FAQ](https://designvortex.co/faq): common questions about commissions, pricing, turnaround, revisions, rights
- [Reviews](https://designvortex.co/reviews): client testimonials
- [Resources](https://designvortex.co/resources): guides and articles for commissioning fantasy character art

## Service pages

- [Character art commissions](https://designvortex.co/services/character-work): bust, half-body, full-body portraits, reference sheets
- [Party portrait commissions](https://designvortex.co/services/party-work): group portraits, matched sets, action scenes
- [VTT token commissions](https://designvortex.co/services/tokens): Roll20, Foundry, Owlbear ready PNGs
- [GM and world-building art](https://designvortex.co/services/gm-world-building): NPC packs, item cards, maps
- [Commercial licensing](https://designvortex.co/commercial): publisher, indie game, and commercial use
- [Subscription](https://designvortex.co/subscription): monthly commission plans for ongoing campaigns

## Key facts about the studio

- 200+ commissions delivered since 2024
- All work is digital painting by a human artist (Hector G.)
- No AI generation or AI-assisted work in any commission
- Pricing is flat-rate and transparent, listed on the pricing page
- Standard turnaround is 2 to 4 weeks per piece (varies by tier)
- 2 revisions included on every commission
- 4K final delivery plus print-ready and transparent PNG variants
- Worldwide client base, USD pricing, Stripe payments
- Commercial licensing available for publishers and indie games
